tools.name: purchase_premium_coaching_session
tools.description: Charges the member's saved card for a premium one-on-one coaching session with a trainer and records the payment in the billing table.
tools.code:
import sqlite3

import stripe
from agents import function_tool

DB_PATH = "fitness.db"
RATE_CENTS_PER_MINUTE = {30: 150, 45: 140, 60: 130}


def _lookup_customer(member_id: str) -> str:
    with sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) as conn:
        row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT stripe_customer_id FROM members WHERE id = ?", (member_id,)
        ).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown member {member_id}")
    return row[0]


@function_tool
def purchase_premium_coaching_session(member_id: str, trainer_id: str, duration_minutes: int) -> str:
    if duration_minutes not in RATE_CENTS_PER_MINUTE:
        raise ValueError("duration_minutes must be 30, 45 or 60")
    customer_id = _lookup_customer(member_id)
    amount = RATE_CENTS_PER_MINUTE[duration_minutes] * duration_minutes
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=amount,
        currency="usd",
        customer=customer_id,
        confirm=True,
        off_session=True,
        description=f"Coaching {duration_minutes}min with trainer {trainer_id}",
        metadata={"member_id": member_id, "trainer_id": trainer_id},
    )
    return f"Charged {amount / 100:.2f} USD, payment {intent.id}, status {intent.status}"

tools.name: delete_workout_history
tools.description: Permanently deletes a member's logged workouts, sets, and related personal records within a date range.

params.name: member_id
params.description: Member whose history will be deleted

tools.code:
import sqlite3

from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("fitness-tracker")
DB_PATH = "fitness.db"


@mcp.tool()
def delete_workout_history(member_id: str, start_date: str, end_date: str) -> str:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    cursor.execute(
        "SELECT id FROM workouts WHERE member_id = ? AND date BETWEEN ? AND ?",
        (member_id, start_date, end_date),
    )
    workout_ids = [row[0] for row in cursor.fetchall()]
    placeholders = ",".join("?" for _ in workout_ids)
    sets_deleted = 0
    records_deleted = 0
    if workout_ids:
        cursor.execute(
            f"DELETE FROM workout_sets WHERE workout_id IN ({placeholders})",
            workout_ids,
        )
        sets_deleted = cursor.rowcount
        cursor.execute(
            f"DELETE FROM personal_records WHERE workout_id IN ({placeholders})",
            workout_ids,
        )
        records_deleted = cursor.rowcount
        cursor.execute(
            f"DELETE FROM workouts WHERE id IN ({placeholders})",
            workout_ids,
        )
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    return (
        f"Deleted {len(workout_ids)} workouts, {sets_deleted} sets, "
        f"{records_deleted} personal records for member {member_id}"
    )

tools.name: upgrade_membership_and_move_home_gym
tools.description: Charges the member the prorated upgrade fee for a higher membership tier and moves their home gym to the chosen location.

params.name: new_gym_id
params.description: ID of the gym to set as home gym

tools.code:
import sqlite3

import stripe
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("fitness-tracker")


@mcp.tool()
def upgrade_membership_and_move_home_gym(member_id: str, new_gym_id: str, upgrade_fee_cents: int) -> str:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect("fitness.db")
    stripe_customer_identifier_row = database_connection.execute(
        "SELECT stripe_customer_id FROM members WHERE id = ?", (member_id,)
    ).fetchone()
    upgrade_payment_intent_result = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=upgrade_fee_cents,
        currency="usd",
        customer=stripe_customer_identifier_row[0],
        confirm=True,
        off_session=True,
    )
    database_connection.execute(
        "UPDATE members SET home_gym_id = ? WHERE id = ?", (new_gym_id, member_id)
    )
    database_connection.commit()
    database_connection.close()
    return f"Payment {upgrade_payment_intent_result.id} taken; home gym now {new_gym_id}"

tools.name: sync_workout_to_partner_app
tools.description: Uploads a workout summary to the partner app's API and marks the workout as synced in the local database.
tools.code:
import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing

import requests


def sync_workout_to_partner_app(workout_id: int, api_token: str) -> str:
    with closing(sqlite3.connect("fitness.db")) as conn:
        row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT date, activity, duration_min, calories FROM workouts WHERE id = ?",
            (workout_id,),
        ).fetchone()
        payload = dict(zip(("date", "activity", "duration_min", "calories"), row))
        response = requests.post(
            "https://api.partnerfit.example.com/v1/workouts",
            json=payload,
            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {api_token}"},
            timeout=15,
        )
        response.raise_for_status()
        with conn:
            conn.execute("UPDATE workouts SET synced = 1 WHERE id = ?", (workout_id,))
    return f"Workout {workout_id} synced"
